hypothesis: Actual as-of METAR dewpoint, wind direction/persistence, cloud and rain transitions add economically meaningful overshoot-tail ranking beyond frozen Core and reduce high-risk Core Carry exposure without broadly suppressing winner shares.
target: Upward exit from the current exact bracket by settlement (overshoot=1).
denominator: Frozen 1,349 Core-scored PIT checkpoints / 801 city-date-bracket state entries / 36 cities / 31 target dates from 2026-06-02 through 2026-07-08; the 136 frozen baseline-selected entries are a secondary sizing denominator.
pit_boundary: IEM ASOS/METAR rows require valid_utc <= decision_snapshot_ts_utc and a latest-row age <=90 minutes. Lag features use only observations with valid_utc <= the lag clock. Archive report timestamps are available but original first-seen ingestion timestamps are not.
model: Frozen Core overshoot logit offset plus one L2-regularized monotone logistic residual. Each engineered feature is pre-oriented so a larger value means more overshoot risk; residual feature coefficients are constrained non-negative and the calibration intercept is unconstrained.
development_protocol: First 8 target dates warm-up; next 15 dates expanding OOF diagnostics. No outcome-based feature, threshold or hyperparameter selection.
forward_protocol: Last 8 historical target dates scored by one fit using only prior dates. Outcomes have been seen by the wider research program, so this is diagnostic historical forward, not clean program-wide forward.
sizing_overlay: For each OOF test date, downsize frozen selected entries from 10 to 5 shares when challenger overshoot probability is above the training selected-entry 80th percentile. Compare with a frozen-Core-risk overlay at its own training 80th percentile and fixed 10.
materiality_rule: Worth a new zero-notional forward collector only if historical forward top-20% overshoot lift is >=1.5x and the sizing overlay reduces at least one-half loss position without sacrificing more winner profit than loss capital saved. Probability deltas alone cannot pass.
uncertainty: Target-date block bootstrap for proper-score deltas; tail counts and per-date policy PnL are reported without pretending six selected losses provide precise inference.
unique_action: Build the actual-transition tail challenger and decide whether to continue it as a complete-score zero-notional forward model. Do not change Core live eligibility or sizing.
